description: Local trigger and behavior evals for the onset-evaluation skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: How is our latest ITGPT checkpoint doing on raw audio with Beat This! versus oracle beat grids?
Run audio grounding checks and inspect the worst failing songs and error slices on this ITGPT checkpoint, plus rank the scoreboard.
Explain mathematically why R-Drop adds symmetric KL divergence between two dropout passes.

behavior_cases.prompt: The user asks: 'How well does our latest ITGPT placement checkpoint work end-to-end on raw audio compared to oracle beat grids?' Give the exact evaluation plan and command.
rubric: Uses scripts/eval_raw_audio_onset.py to compare oracle vs Beat This! modes on +/-20 ms event F1.
Does not mix M-slot48 placement F1 and +/-20 ms raw-audio event F1 into a single incompatible comparison column.

behavior_cases.prompt: We finished training an ITGPT-MERT placement checkpoint on Stage 1. What exact eval command and pass gates must we check before promoting it as champion?
rubric: Checks both audio grounding thresholds (shuffle >= 0.08 and zeros >= 0.10) alongside M-slot48 F1.
Inspects eval_val_breakdown.json slices before promoting rather than trusting aggregate F1 alone.
